title: Disco Elysium – The Final Cut
shortDescription: A dialogue-driven detective role-playing game where competing inner skills make investigation, failure, and self-definition part of the same experience.
highlights: Skill voices turn character building into an active narrative lens
Choices make even a stalled investigation feel revealing rather than wasted

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A major PC role-playing recommendation for players who want expressive choices and dense investigative writing without combat-first structure.
